items.statement: The submitted investigation validates the four labeled structures as stationary minima and records an auditable energy ledger before deriving observables.
items.expected: All four labels have validation records; the protocol reports no imaginary frequencies for minima or clearly documents bounded failures; energies and formulas are traceable.

items.statement: The oxidation potentials are reported for couples 1/2 and 3/4 on the SCE-in-MeCN scale.
items.expected: E(1/2) is approximately +1.33 V and E(3/4) approximately −0.54 V, with the stated reference and units.

items.statement: The C–H BDEs are reported for labeled species 1 and 2.
items.expected: BDE(1) is approximately 76.1 kcal/mol and BDE(2) approximately 32.9 kcal/mol.
